facility.docs:
**int**: The syslog facility to use. Defaults to `16` (corresponding to `local0`  ).

*See also: [Syslog Component](https://esphome.io/components/syslog#configuration-options)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used for code generation.

*See also: [Syslog Component](https://esphome.io/components/syslog#configuration-options)*

level.docs:
**string**: The highest log level to send to the syslog server. Defaults to `DEBUG`.

*See also: [Syslog Component](https://esphome.io/components/syslog#configuration-options)*

port.docs:
**int**: The port to send logs to. Defaults to `514`.

*See also: [Syslog Component](https://esphome.io/components/syslog#configuration-options)*

time_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the time client to use for time-stamping logs. May be omitted if only one time client is configured.

*See also: [Syslog Component](https://esphome.io/components/syslog#configuration-options)*

udp_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the UDP client to use for sending logs. May be omitted if only one UDP client is configured.

*See also: [Syslog Component](https://esphome.io/components/syslog#configuration-options)*
